rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments with no dnsConfig options set, an opinionated DNS-setting policy that is not one of the four smell categories (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: DNS configuration options concern workload configuration correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Flags liveness probes pointing at a port the container does not expose, so the probe misbehaves at runtime (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Liveness probe port configuration concerns operational correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Flags containers without a liveness probe, so hung containers are not restarted (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Missing liveness probes weaken workload health management.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments with no node affinity, an opinionated scheduling-placement policy outside the four categories (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Node affinity governs workload placement across nodes.

rater_1_rationale: Flags containers without a readiness probe, so traffic may reach pods that are not ready (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Missing readiness probes impair service readiness management.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments not using a rolling update strategy, risking service disruption during updates (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Deployment update strategy affects safe rollout behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Flags PodDisruptionBudgets that do not set unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy, which affects eviction behaviour of unhealthy pods (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Eviction policy governs operational disruption behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Flags objects without a valid owner email annotation, an organisational metadata policy rather than a smell category (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Required ownership annotations concern configuration metadata quality.

rater_1_rationale: Flags objects without an owner label, an organisational metadata policy rather than a smell category (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Owner labels support configuration accountability and maintenance.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployment-like objects without a restart policy of Always or OnFailure, reducing fault tolerance (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Restart policy concerns workload execution configuration.

rater_1_rationale: Flags YAML keys that are not in alphabetical order, a pure style preference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
rater_2_rationale: Consistent key ordering concerns manifest maintainability.

rater_1_rationale: Checks that CronJobs configure a deadline, which governs runtime behaviour of missed or late runs (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
rater_2_rationale: CronJob deadlines govern scheduled job execution behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Checks that CronJobs have a valid RestartPolicy, a runtime-reliability setting (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
rater_2_rationale: CronJob restart policy concerns job configuration correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Checks that Deployments targeted by a Service use RollingUpdate, avoiding downtime during updates (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
Checks that Pods have safe probe configurations, a runtime-reliability control (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
rater_2_rationale: Health probes support workload operational correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Checks that readiness and liveness probes are not identical, a probe-reliability rule (kube-score v1.20.0 README_CHECKS).
rater_2_rationale: Identical probes can indicate poorly differentiated health checks.
